findings.quote: AI is the most powerful new lever we have to advance the Charter's vision of social progress, better standards of life.
findings.rationale: Describes transformative AI, national growth strategy and applications in fraud detection and healthcare.

findings.quote: Only by cooperation together can we set artificial intelligence on the right millennia-defining course.
findings.rationale: Examines AI healthcare benefits, inequality, disinformation and criminal misuse and urges cooperation.

findings.quote: And I welcome the new global dialogue on AI governance.
findings.rationale: Supports UN AI governance bodies, AI security research and international development applications.
